result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Reconcile your account with a YAML manifest (infrastructure-as-code)

USAGE:
    steadycron sync [MANIFEST] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    steadycron sync jobs.yaml
    steadycron sync jobs.yaml --dry-run
    steadycron sync jobs.yaml --prune --yes

ARGUMENTS:
    [MANIFEST]    Path to the YAML manifest (default: jobs.yaml)

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help             Prints help information                              
        --api-key <KEY>    SteadyCron API key (sc_…). Overrides                 
                           $STEADYCRON_API_KEY and the config file              
        --api-url <URL>    API base URL. Overrides $STEADYCRON_API_URL and the  
                           config file. Default: https://api.steadycron.com     
        --json             Emit machine-readable JSON on stdout instead of      
                           formatted text                                       
        --no-color         Disable ANSI colors in output                        
    -q, --quiet            Suppress non-essential output                        
        --dry-run          Show what would change without applying anything     
        --prune            Delete jobs that exist on the server but are not in  
                           the manifest                                         
    -y, --yes              Apply without the interactive confirmation prompt

DESCRIPTION:
Create a single job from flags

USAGE:
    steadycron jobs create [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                          Prints help information                 
        --api-key <KEY>                 SteadyCron API key (sc_…). Overrides    
                                        $STEADYCRON_API_KEY and the config file 
        --api-url <URL>                 API base URL. Overrides                 
                                        $STEADYCRON_API_URL and the config file.
                                        Default: https://api.steadycron.com     
        --json                          Emit machine-readable JSON on stdout    
                                        instead of formatted text               
        --no-color                      Disable ANSI colors in output           
    -q, --quiet                         Suppress non-essential output           
        --name <NAME>                   Job name (unique within the account)    
        --kind <KIND>                   http (default) or heartbeat             
        --description <TEXT>                                                    
        --schedule <CRON>               Cron expression, e.g. "0 9 * * 1".      
                                        Mutually exclusive with --interval      
        --interval <SECONDS>            Interval in seconds (10–86400). Mutually
                                        exclusive with --schedule               
        --timezone <TZ>                 IANA timezone (default UTC)             
        --paused                        Create the job in a paused state        
        --method <METHOD>               http: GET (default), POST, PUT, PATCH,  
                                        DELETE                                  
        --url <URL>                     http: target URL (required for HTTP     
                                        jobs)                                   
        --header <HEADER>               http: request header as 'Name: value'   
     
[truncated]
